scientific_integrity: The image theorem and maximal nilpotent-subspace theorem are credited; the quantified claim is the full fiber distribution. Symbolic case proof and finite verifier are distinct forms of evidence; independent audit is unperformed.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to the associative product map on strictly upper-triangular four-by-four matrices over finite fields; no assertion for larger sizes or other words. A possible equivalent historical formula remains a bibliographic risk.
title: Four product-fiber strata in the strictly upper-triangular \(4\times4\) algebra
